Bayes es el teorema que más malentendido: Bayes is the theorem that prevents the most misunderstandings, and here the warning left open in the first topic of the course is closed. Imagine a test that is right 99 % of the time for a disease that 1 person in 10 000 has. If you test positive, the probability of being ill is not 99 %: it is around 1 %, because the false positives among the 9999 healthy people far outnumber the true ones. Courts have convicted innocent people for ignoring this, and that is why spam filters, automatic diagnosis and fraud detection systems are built on this formula.

Thomas Bayes era un pastor presbiteriano: Thomas Bayes was a Presbyterian minister and his theorem was published in 1763, two years after his death, because a friend found the manuscript among his papers and sent it to the Royal Society. It was forgotten or outright disdained for much of the twentieth century; it was accused of being unrigorous for incorporating prior beliefs. Today it is the basis of spam filters, of automatic diagnosis and of a good part of machine learning.
